summary.text: Johnathan Newman is a Republican state representative and pastor who has represented Ohio House District 80 since January 1, 2025, and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
Ballotpedia lists his career experience as a pastor.

paragraphs.text: Newman earned bachelor's degrees in theology and sociology from Union University and a master's degree in theology from Mid-America Baptist Theological Seminary.
He won the November 5, 2024 general election over Democrat Melissa VanDyke.
Ballotpedia lists his committees as Community Revitalization, Education, Agriculture (vice chair) and Transportation.
Katie Koehler Wagner is the Democratic candidate in the 2026 general election.
